documents.title: APU AI Policy: Responsible and Ethical AI Use
documents.quality_note: Student AI policy with definitions, permitted and prohibited uses, citation rules, faculty discretion, consequences and FAQ.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence (A.I.) Classroom Use Policies: A Syllabus Resource for Instructors
documents.quality_note: Three-option syllabus tiers (no / partial / full AI use) plus assignment redesign strategies. Predates the fall 2025 policy, so parts may be partly superseded; kept because it adds tier content the newer policy lacks.

documents.title: Academic Integrity (graduate catalog policy)
documents.quality_note: One AI sentence in a 43k-character document: students may not use AI-generated materials for credit without permission. Kept as the binding integrity-policy hook for the AI rules. It is the graduate catalog; an undergraduate version was not fetched.
